title: audio.set
description: Changes the audio device setup as OpenTune's audio settings page does: the members given replace those of the current setup, and the device is opened again with the result; playback stops while it reopens. Values that the instance does not offer (audio.get, available) give INVALID_ARGUMENT(audio_setting_unavailable) and change nothing. If the device cannot be opened with the new setup, the server restores the previous setup, as the settings page does, and the call fails with IO_ERROR(device_open_failed) and executed false; if the previous setup cannot be opened either, executed is true and no device runs (audio.get reports it). The setup is a user-global setting: changes lists it (entity audioDevice) and the result carries the warning GLOBAL_PREFERENCE (data {preferences}, with the name audioDevice). There is no undo entry (undo reason ui_parity), and the revert recipe sets the previous values with audio.set. device is the setup after the call. A setup equal to the current one is a no-op.
